newsitem.title: USA: Coastal closes on sale of coal operations.
newsitem.headline: Coastal closes on sale of coal operations.

text.p: The Coastal Corp said Monday it completed the closing of the sale of its western coal operations for $615 million in cash to subsidiaries of Atlantic Richfield Co of Los Angeles, Calif., and ITOCHU Corp of Japan.

The sale included the operations of subsidiaries Coastal States Energy Co, Southern Utah Fuel Co (SUFCO), Soldier Creek Coal Co, and Skyline Coal Co, which operated mines in Utah with reserves of about 300 million tons. The sale also included Coastal's 9-percent interest in the Los Angeles Export Terminal Co Inc.

Coastal's ANR Coal Co and its subsidiaries will continue their operations in the eastern United States, which include operating mines and processing plants and marketing coal from an extensive reserve base in West Virginia, Virginia, and Kentucky.
